_comment: Navigator GCS recording archived from ~/vayu-logs into log-analysis (2026-06-26) to match the setup.json convention. Decoders: tools/telemetry/{analyze_pitch_osc,pitch_verify,pitch_lag}.py.
capture_type: ~10 min open-air piloted INDI (k=20) flight (angle_sp up to 100 deg; mostly grounded between brief flights, lossy long session ~26 Hz effective).

hardware.airframe: X-quad. M1,M3 CW / M2,M4 CCW. IMU aligned. A motor was burned earlier in the 2026-06-25 session.
hardware.recorder: Navigator GCS telemetry recording (RecordFormat VREC), copied from ~/vayu-logs/

motor_geometry._comment: Inverted spin vs firmware default (flips s_mix_yaw only). Roll/pitch mix unchanged. REQUIRED.

firmware.tune_applied: NONE — compiled rate_indi.h defaults (INDI uses b/k/lpf; PID struct inactive).
firmware.note: k=20 first INDI build — hunts at ~3.3 Hz (= its own bandwidth).

indi._units: b = wdot/u [deg/s^2 per unit u] (sysid K); k = outer bandwidth [1/s]; lpf_rc = sync filter [s].
indi.status: UNFIT placeholders; k=20 too hot -> broadband hunt.

result_metrics.decomp: outer loop clean; BOTH axes hunt equally; hunt freq ~= k (3.18 Hz) -> no phase margin at crossover.

headline: INDI k=20 hunts broadband at ~3.3 Hz = its own bandwidth. ~2x tighter than PID at matched throttle but the hunt is the bandwidth being too hot. Drove the k=6 seed retune.
